title: Edge
description: Canonical schema for a directed edge between two skill nodes.

source.description: Source skill ID (must match a skill.id in the graph).

target.description: Target skill ID (must match a skill.id in the graph).

evidence.description: Verbatim text excerpt that triggered this edge extraction.

source_file.description: Relative path to the markdown file from which this edge was extracted.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. high = explicit keyword match; medium = contextual; low = inferred.
